story.titleZh: 车手称马德里赛道首秀乏味：“我差点睡着了”
story.summaryZh: 在马德里赛道赛道完成F1首秀后，车手们对比赛过程反应冷淡，有车手表示“我差点睡着了”。车手们认为这条赛道存在主要问题，并提出了各自的解决方案。
story.originalTitle: 'I almost fell asleep' - drivers react to dull Madring F1 debut
story.summaryEn: After making their F1 debut at the Madring circuit, drivers gave a lukewarm reaction to the race, with one saying "I almost fell asleep." Drivers identified main problems with the track and proposed their own solutions.
detailZh: 2026年西班牙大奖赛是一场沉闷的游行——但F1车手们认为马德里赛道赛道的主要问题是什么，他们又提出了哪些解决方案？
马德里赛道赛道部分是新建的永久性赛道，部分是利用现有道路，这些道路蜿蜒穿过马德里东北部的IFEMA会议中心。因此，它受益于部分空白画布。
在最近接受《建筑文摘》采访时，设计师Jarno Zaffelli表示：“测试非常积极，所以我很兴奋想看看F1会怎么说，”
“在我看来，就流畅性而言，没有其他赛道具有这种独特的个性。”
“我希望它能给车手和车迷带来独特的感受。我也希望人们离开时能认识到，建造一条不无聊的街道赛道是可能的。”
至少是一条不无聊的街道赛道。而比赛……则是另一回事。
车手们对马德里首场比赛的评价
车手们对马德里赛道赛道的位置和氛围一致好评，包括费尔南多·阿隆索、卡洛斯·塞恩斯、刘易斯·汉密尔顿和阿尔维德·林德布拉德在内的车手都对赛道外的体验赞不绝口。
但林德布拉德承认这“不是最激动人心的比赛”，而奥迪的加布里埃尔·博托莱托被问及驾驶起来是否像一些观众看起来那样沉闷。
“是的，我也差点睡着了，”这位巴西人回答道。
哈斯车队的埃斯特班·奥康表示，周日缺乏轮胎磨损和颗粒化导致比赛无聊。
“从进站到结束，就像120%的强度。因为颗粒化没有发生，我们就到了这个地步。如果我们周五有比赛，会好得多。”
赛道布局本身招致了更严厉的批评。
马克斯·维斯塔潘在第一圈首个减速弯冲出赛道，这概括了那里超车空间有多小，而5-6号减速弯被指太窄，倾斜的La Monumental弯之后的各种左弯也给车手留下的空间很小。
“我不知道怎么会有人看着这个设计说，太棒了！”迈凯伦的兰多·诺里斯在新闻发布会上说。
许多弯道视野也很差，包括塞恩斯在内的车手指出了安全隐患。
“和吉达、巴库一样，很差，”他说。“但国际汽联似乎乐于在新赛道方面朝这个方向前进，作为车手，我们显然在提出我们的……不是担忧——而是我们希望不断改善安全的观点。”
“我们将走向这些赛道，因为在无法看穿的S弯以260公里/小时、270公里/小时[162-168英里/小时]行驶绝对令人大开眼界，绝对让你质疑一切是否安全。”
同胞阿隆索给La Monumental弯的炒作泼了冷水，他说他的阿斯顿·马丁新闻官都能全油门通过那个弯。
“很可悲，你知道，某种程度上，用这一代赛车来到像这样非常好的赛道，这里那里有挑战，比如Monumental弯、12号弯，而车手输入根本不算什么。”
“迈克尔[克莱顿，新闻官]都能开12号弯，因为你全油门通过，没有能量部署，”他说。
乔治·拉塞尔谈到了赛道的一个根本问题。
“我想设计中的一个小挫折就是缺乏明确的超车机会。在每条赛道上，长直道尽头都需要明确的超车机会，而这里最长的直道通向那个狭窄的环岛路段。所以这可能是我们唯一希望有所不同的事情。”
诺里斯直言不讳地说：“他们应该取消[18-19号弯]——没用。”
他解释说，赛道可以通过“从[17号弯]直线到20号弯，拥有像奥斯汀1号弯或奥斯汀10号弯那样宽得多的入口”来改进。
“一个大发夹弯，你为所有人创造更好的机会，你就能享受比赛。有一些简单的改变，也许还有一些更棘手的，比如5、6、7号弯。”
凯迪拉克的瓦尔特利·博塔斯表示，在最长的直道之后“很容易”阻挡，呼应了拉塞尔的评论。
他补充说：“我不太喜欢的是第二和第三赛段，太盲了，尤其是慢圈时。有时有点危险，有些地方不必要地盲。但那是我们第一次去沙特时，同样的问题，然后他们加宽了一些墙壁，所以我不知道——也许有改进的空间。”
除了13号弯（左弯）和20号弯（急左弯）外，5号弯招致了最多的批评，因为虽然它是一个重刹车区，但减速弯的入口颠簸，路肩很高，赛道仍然狭窄——基本上排除了超车。
威廉姆斯的亚历克斯·阿尔本说：“我认为我们需要稍微重新审视这条赛道……因为我认为，我不知道你们有没有看F3和F2的比赛，但都是车手在减速弯并排，然后抱怨其中一个没让他们回超，所以那个弯特别是我认为最需要改进的弯。”
博托莱托质疑5-6号减速弯的设置。
“我就是不明白……即使他们减慢弯道速度，他们要做什么，你知道……特别是现在我们的大赛车；如果是1990年代的赛车，也许可以放点什么，但现在不是这样了。”
并且，呼应阿隆索对La Monumental弯的直率，维斯塔潘说：“是的，我是说，倾斜很酷，但我认为他们应该反过来做。最初更多倾斜，然后只是变平。”
也许街道赛道本身就不适合现代F1赛车笨重的尺寸。
维斯塔潘说：“我不喜欢街道赛道，所以那永远不会改变。我总是更喜欢在像斯帕这样的赛道上驾驶。”
“他们所做的事情，他们建造一切的方式，我认为他们做得非常好，但我不喜欢街道赛道。”
顺便说一句，阿隆索也发表了类似的评论：“我仍然更喜欢常规赛道。你知道，一般来说，你推动赛车的极限……在街道赛道上，你总是95%，因为赛道总是让你惊讶。”
对马德里赛道布局的批评并非没有意义，因为下一届西班牙大奖赛已经在讨论改变——很明显，车手们不怕明确表达自己的意见。
detailEn: The 2026 Spanish Grand Prix was a procession - but what do Formula 1 drivers think is the main problem with the Madring, and what are their proposed solutions?

The Madring is part new, permanent circuit, and part existing roads that flow in and out of the IFEMA conference centre in the north-east of Madrid. It therefore benefitted from a partial blank slate.
In a recent interview with Architectural Digest, designer Jarno Zaffelli said: "Testing was very positive, so I am quite excited to see what Formula 1 has to say,"
"No other course has this particular character, in my opinion, in terms of its flow.
"I hope it gives the drivers and fans a unique feeling. And I would hope that people walk away recognising that it's possible to build a street circuit that is not boring."
A street circuit that's not boring, at least. The race… a different story.
What the drivers said about Madrid's first race

There was consistent praise over the location and the atmosphere at the Madring with drivers including Fernando Alonso, Carlos Sainz, Lewis Hamilton and Arvid Lindblad among those enthusing over the off-track experience.
But Lindblad did concede that it "wasn't the most exciting race" while Audi's Gabriel Bortoleto was asked whether it was as dull to drive as it was for some watching.
"Yeah, I almost fell asleep as well," replied the Brazilian.
Haas's Esteban Ocon said that a lack of tyre degradation and graining on Sunday made for a boring race.
"It was like 120% from as soon as you pitted to the end. And because the graining didn't happen, that's where we ended up. If we had a race on Friday, it would have been much better."
The track layout itself garnered heavier criticism.

Max Verstappen's lap one off at the opening chicane summed up how little space there was to pass there, while the Turn 5-6 chicane was branded too narrow and the various left-handers after the banked La Monumental gave drivers little room.
"I don't know how someone looks at this design and goes, mint!" said McLaren's Lando Norris in the press conference.
A lot of the corners also offer little visibility, and drivers including Sainz pointed out safety concerns.

"Same as in Jeddah and Baku, it's poor," he said. "But it seems like the FIA is happy to go in this direction moving forward in terms of new circuits, which obviously, as drivers, we are raising our… not concerns - but our point of wanting to keep improving safety.

"We're going to go towards these circuits because going at 260km/h, 270km/h [162-168mph] on esses that you cannot see through is definitely eye-opening and definitely makes you question how safe everything is."
Compatriot Alonso deflated the hype around La Monumental as he said his Aston Martin press officer could have taken the corner flat out.

"It is sad, you know, in a way, with this generation of cars to come to a very nice circuit like this one, with challenges here and there, like Monumental corner, Turn 12, and the driver input is just nothing.
"Michael [Clayton, press officer] can drive in Turn 12 because you go flat with no deployment," he said.
George Russell touched on a fundamental issue with the track.

"I guess the one small frustration in the design is just the lack of clear overtaking opportunities. On every track, at the end of a long straight, you need a clear opportunity to overtake, and the longest straight here goes into that tight roundabout section. So that's probably the only thing we wish was different."
Norris was forthright, saying: "They should get rid of [Turns] 18-19 - useless."
He explained that the track could be improved with a "straight line from [Turn] 17 straight to 20, have a much wider entry like Austin Turn 1 or Turn 10 in Austin.
"A big hairpin, you create much better opportunities for everyone and you'll be able to enjoy the race. There's some simple changes and maybe some trickier ones like Turn 5, 6, 7."
Cadillac's Valtteri Bottas said it was "quite easy" to block after the longest straight, echoing Russell's comments.

He added: "What I'm not a big fan of is the sector two and three, how blind it is, especially people on the slow laps. Sometimes it's a bit sketchy, unnecessarily blind in places. But that was the first time we went to Saudi, it was the same issue and then they widened some of the walls, so I don't know - maybe there's some room for improvement."

Aside from Turns 13 (left-hand kink) and 20 (sharp left-hander), Turn 5 garnered the most criticism as, while it's a heavy braking zone, the entry to the chicane is bumpy, there are high kerbs, and the track is still narrow - essentially ruling it out for overtakes.

Williams's Alex Albon said: "I think we need to revisit this track a little bit… because I think, I don't know if you watched the F3 and F2 races, but it was all drivers going side by side in the chicane and then complaining that one of them didn't let them back past, so that corner in particular is the corner that I think needs the most work."
Bortoleto questioned the inclusion of that Turn 5-6 chicane.

"I just don't see how… Like even if they slow down the corner, what are they going to do, you know… especially with the big cars we have nowadays; if it was 1990s cars, maybe you could put something, but it's not like this anymore."

And, echoing Alonso's bluntness over La Monumental, Verstappen said: "Yeah, I mean, it's cool, the banking, but I think they should have done it the other way around, though. Initially more banking and then just flatten it out."
Perhaps street circuits themselves just don't suit the cumbersome footprint of a modern F1 car.
Verstappen said: "I'm not a fan of street circuits, so that will never change. I will always prefer to drive on a track like Spa.
"What they have done, the way they have built everything up, I think they have done a really good job, but I'm not a fan of street circuits."

Alonso, incidentally, shared a similar comment: "I still prefer normal circuits. You know, in general, you push the limits of the car… On a street circuit, you are always 95% because the track is always surprising you."

The criticism over Madring's layout isn't for nothing as changes are already being discussed for the next iteration of the Spanish Grand Prix - and it's clear that the drivers aren't afraid of making their opinions clear.
keyPointsZh: 多位车手称赞马德里赛道的位置和氛围，但对赛道布局提出批评。
车手指出赛道缺乏超车机会、部分弯道视野差且存在安全隐患。
诺里斯建议取消18-19号弯，并改造17至20号弯区域以创造更好超车机会。
keyPointsEn: Several drivers praised the location and atmosphere of the Madrid circuit but criticized the track layout.
Drivers pointed out a lack of overtaking opportunities, poor visibility in some corners, and safety concerns.
Norris suggested removing Turns 18-19 and redesigning the Turn 17 to 20 section to create better overtaking opportunities.

以下是排位赛三部分的全部结果：

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.
keyPointsZh: 倍耐力在击败普利司通的竞争性报价后赢得2025至2027年的F1轮胎供应合同，今年6月国际汽联行使选择权将合同延长一个赛季。
国际汽联将从2029年起启动新的招标程序，届时预计将出现新的竞争以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
